metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based product streams for the Internet Number Registry and Routing Trust domain.

definitions.productBrick: A reusable implementation-facing building block used to realize one or more registry, routing trust, DNS, measurement, policy, or learning experiences.
definitions.productStream: A high-level outcome-based experience that combines product bricks into customer or public-interest value.

rootGroups.name: Registry and Routing Trust Journeys
rootGroups.description: Streams that combine member, registry, routing security, DNS, and measurement bricks into customer-relevant outcomes.

streams.name: Join and Operate as a Local Internet Registry
streams.description: Help an organization become a RIPE NCC member, activate its LIR account, understand obligations, and operate registry workflows with low effort.
outcomes: More accurate member and resource-holder data

flows.title: Join and Operate as a Local Internet Registry
flows.description: Move from membership intent to a working LIR account with clear billing, roles, and service access.

steps.title: Evaluate membership fit
keyFacts: Organizations need clarity on fees, obligations, resource eligibility, and expected effort before joining.
painPoints: Teams can delay joining when legal, billing, and technical responsibilities are unclear.

dependencies.name: Membership Lifecycle
dependencies.how: Gives the applicant a single source of truth for status and next action.

steps.title: Activate member workspace
keyFacts: New members need account roles, service access, and guided next steps immediately after approval.
painPoints: Member value is delayed when portal permissions, contacts, and first tasks are fragmented.

dependencies.name: LIR Portal Workspace
dependencies.how: Provides account administration, task inbox, and resource service entry points.

dependencies.name: Maintainer and Access Control
dependencies.description: Controls authority for registry object updates.
dependencies.how: Ensures new member roles and maintainers can safely operate registry objects.

steps.title: Build operating confidence
keyFacts: Members sustain good registry hygiene when training and certification connect directly to recurring tasks.
painPoints: Operational mistakes increase when new LIRs learn policies only through support tickets.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: RIPE NCC Access and finance systems
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide authentication and payment state required for membership activation.

streams.name: Request and Maintain Number Resources
streams.description: Support IPv4, IPv6, and AS Number request, assignment, update, reverse DNS, and registry data maintenance workflows.

flows.title: Request and Maintain Number Resources
flows.description: Progress from resource need to registered, delegated, and maintained resource state.

steps.title: Prepare resource case
keyFacts: The operator must know which resource type fits the business need and which evidence is required.
painPoints: Incomplete justification, unclear contacts, and missing network plans slow the request.

dependencies.name: AS Number Registry
dependencies.description: Supports ASN requests and routing reference state.
dependencies.how: Captures routing independence and ASN assignment details.

steps.title: Register and delegate
keyFacts: Registry, reverse DNS, and abuse contact state must be consistent before production use.
painPoints: Operators lose trust when registry and DNS state diverge or contacts are stale.

dependencies.name: Abuse Contact Registry
dependencies.how: Keeps incident routing contact data usable.

steps.title: Review and correct
keyFacts: Periodic review is needed to keep registry data trustworthy after organization and network changes.
painPoints: Data quality degrades when member records are updated only during emergencies.

dependencies.name: Assisted Registry Check
dependencies.description: Reviews registry accuracy and drives remediation.
dependencies.how: Closes the loop between records, contacts, and member operations.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: Member network planning and DNS systems
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.interface: address plans, route plans, authoritative DNS
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide source evidence and operational configuration for registered resources.

streams.name: Transfer and Reconcile Resources
streams.description: Help members and resource holders complete transfers, mergers, acquisitions, and registry corrections without losing trust or traceability.
outcomes: Better traceability for scarce IPv4 resources

flows.title: Transfer and Reconcile Resources
flows.description: Move resources between holders while preserving policy compliance and accurate registry state.

steps.title: Validate parties and resources
keyFacts: Transfer risk depends on holder legitimacy, documentation, registry status, and policy eligibility.
painPoints: Unclear ownership or incomplete corporate evidence can block scarce IPv4 transfers.

dependencies.name: Resource Transfers and Mergers
dependencies.how: Keeps evidence, parties, and approvals in one auditable workflow.

steps.title: Settle service state
keyFacts: Member standing, billing state, and LIR account closure can affect transfer completion.
painPoints: Transfers stall when service and finance state are handled outside the case workflow.

dependencies.name: Billing and Charging Scheme
dependencies.how: Aligns service eligibility and financial obligations before final registry updates.

steps.title: Publish final registry state
keyFacts: Downstream operators rely on current registry and routing context after a transfer.
painPoints: Partial updates create confusion in Whois, RPKI, reverse DNS, and incident response.

dependencies.name: IPv4 Allocation and Waiting List
dependencies.how: Updates scarce address resource ownership and lifecycle state.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: Peer RIRs, legal documents, and corporate registries
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide evidence and cross-registry coordination for resource-holder changes.

streams.name: Secure Routing with RPKI
streams.description: Enable operators to certify resources, create ROAs, prepare for emerging routing security standards, and monitor route validity.
outcomes: Higher IPv4 and IPv6 ROA coverage
Greater confidence in BGP origin validation

flows.title: Secure Routing with RPKI
flows.description: Move from uncertified resources to monitored route authorizations and operational competence.

steps.title: Activate certification
keyFacts: Resource holders need verifiable proof of registration before routing authorizations can be trusted.
painPoints: Teams hesitate when key management, publication, and operational implications are unclear.

dependencies.name: Hosted RPKI Certification Authority
dependencies.how: Establishes the trust anchor for routing authorization.

steps.title: Create authorizations
keyFacts: ROA accuracy depends on current prefix, origin ASN, and max-length decisions.
painPoints: Incorrect ROAs can create invalid route announcements and production risk.

dependencies.name: Route Origin Authorization Management
dependencies.description: Creates and publishes route origin authorizations.
dependencies.how: Provides guided authoring and validation before publication.

steps.title: Monitor and learn
keyFacts: Routing security is sustained when operators monitor validity and build internal skill.
painPoints: ROA drift happens when routing changes are not tied to registry and education workflows.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: BGP routers, validators, and NRO RPKI coordination
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.interface: RPKI repositories and BGP origin validation
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Consume and validate published routing authorization data.

streams.name: Operate Reverse DNS and Root Services
streams.description: Provide reliable reverse DNS, authoritative DNS, K-root, and DNS monitoring services for members and the Internet community.
outcomes: Operational continuity for critical Internet services

flows.title: Operate Reverse DNS and Root Services
flows.description: Keep DNS delegation, root-service reachability, and authoritative service quality visible and reliable.

steps.title: Configure DNS authority
keyFacts: Operators need valid delegation and DNSSEC state before relying on reverse DNS.
painPoints: Broken delegations and stale authoritative records undermine incident response and reputation.

dependencies.name: Reverse DNS Delegation
dependencies.description: Manages reverse DNS and DNSSEC state.
dependencies.how: Validates changes and publishes authoritative delegation records.

steps.title: Operate critical nodes
keyFacts: Root and authoritative DNS services require distributed, monitored, and resilient operations.
painPoints: Operators need transparency when node reachability or routing changes affect users.

dependencies.name: K-root Operations
dependencies.description: Operates K-root nodes and service health.
dependencies.how: Keeps root-service operations observable and coordinated.

dependencies.name: AuthDNS and DNSMON
dependencies.how: Monitors and publishes service health signals.

steps.title: Measure DNS reachability
keyFacts: Global reachability and latency evidence helps diagnose regional DNS problems.
painPoints: DNS incidents are harder to resolve when measurement is not available from affected regions.

dependencies.name: RIPE Atlas Measurement Network
dependencies.how: Gives DNS operations external visibility into service behavior.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: Root server system, DNS operators, and hosting partners
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide hosting, peering, and ecosystem coordination for DNS services.

streams.name: Investigate Routing and Connectivity
streams.description: Help operators, researchers, and public-interest analysts understand routing events, reachability, geolocation, and Internet health using RIPE Atlas, RIS, RIPEstat, and public datasets.
outcomes: More evidence-based policy and operations decisions

flows.title: Investigate Routing and Connectivity
flows.description: Move from observed problem or research question to repeatable measurement, analysis, and publication.

steps.title: Collect evidence
keyFacts: Routing and connectivity questions need diverse active and passive evidence.
painPoints: Single vantage-point evidence can mislead operators during regional incidents.

dependencies.name: Routing Information Service
dependencies.how: Adds routing control-plane evidence to the investigation.

steps.title: Analyze resource context
keyFacts: Investigations need registry, RPKI, routing, and geolocation context around the same resource.
painPoints: Operators waste time reconciling inconsistent tools and resource identifiers.

dependencies.name: RIPE Database and RDAP Publication
dependencies.description: Provides registry objects, contact context, route objects, and public lookup surfaces.
dependencies.how: Anchors investigation output in authoritative registry publication rather than detached measurements.

steps.title: Publish and reuse
keyFacts: Shared datasets and country reports help the wider community reuse evidence.
painPoints: Ad hoc analysis loses value when data provenance and publication paths are weak.

dependencies.name: Raw Dataset Publication
dependencies.description: Publishes reusable measurement and routing datasets.
dependencies.how: Makes analysis reproducible and reusable.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: Probe hosts, route collector peers, and public data consumers
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide data collection vantage points and consume published evidence.

streams.name: Participate in Policy and Governance
streams.description: Help members and community participants understand proposals, bring evidence, participate in meetings, and see implementation status.

flows.title: Participate in Policy and Governance
flows.description: Connect policy awareness, evidence, discussion, and implementation status.

steps.title: Discover policy relevance
keyFacts: Participants need to know which proposals affect their resources, operations, or region.
painPoints: Busy operators miss policy changes when relevance is not obvious.

dependencies.name: Policy Development Process Support
dependencies.description: Tracks proposal state and implementation status.
dependencies.how: Makes proposals easier to find and understand.

steps.title: Bring evidence to discussion
keyFacts: Policy legitimacy improves when discussion is grounded in registry and measurement evidence.
painPoints: Debates become less productive when participants cannot inspect data behind claims.

dependencies.name: RIPEstat Analysis Surface
dependencies.how: Supports transparent data-backed proposals and objections.

steps.title: Track implementation impact
keyFacts: After consensus, members need to know when policy changes will alter workflows or obligations.
painPoints: Implementation surprises create support load and reduce trust in the process.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: RIPE community working groups and mailing lists
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Provide the community process in which policy proposals are shaped.

streams.name: Learn and Certify Internet Operations
streams.description: Help network operators build practical stream in LIR operations, RIPE Database, IPv6, DNS, BGP security, and routing security.
outcomes: More confident IPv6 and routing security adoption

flows.title: Learn and Certify Internet Operations
flows.description: Move from skills gap to applied learning, credentialed competence, and repeated operational use.

steps.title: Identify skill gap
keyFacts: Operators often need just-in-time help before a real registry or routing task.
painPoints: Generic training is less effective when not tied to current operational responsibilities.

dependencies.name: RIPE NCC Academy
dependencies.how: Maps tasks to relevant learning modules.

steps.title: Practice and validate
keyFacts: Credentialed skills help employers and communities trust operator readiness.
painPoints: Unverified knowledge can lead to mistakes in live routing and registry systems.

dependencies.name: Certified Professionals
dependencies.how: Turns training progress into trusted competence signals.

steps.title: Apply to production
keyFacts: Learning has business value when it reduces production errors and improves adoption.
painPoints: Training impact is hard to prove without ties to real IPv6, RPKI, and registry work.

externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.system: Exam delivery provider and operator employers
externalSystemsThisStreamDependsOn.description: Support credential validation and employer adoption of training paths.
